verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the square sitting in a centred column, with wide empty bands on both sides. The quote's right edge runs into the purple circle, 'soon.' is left alone on its own line, and the attribution and logo are tiny at this size. B actually uses the banner shape: the quote is on the left, reads well, and has no orphan line. Its flaws are a big empty gap between the quote mark and the quote, a can so large it competes with the headline and nearly touches the top edge, and a logo stuck awkwardly on the circle under the can instead of anchored with the text.
